verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SDK code snippets, sandbox merchant accounts, Markdown/llms.txt docs, and an MCP server, but nothing documents an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Static snippets and sandbox testing are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
